En particulier, il/elle apporte son expertise afin d'élaborer et produire de nouveaux outils de suivi statistique de la délinquance permettant notamment aux forces de sécurité intérieure (FSI) d'en tirer des enseignements opérationnels. Le poste Descriptif du poste CONTEXT Animal behavior exhibits large inter- and intra-individual variability, reflecting complex interactions between internal neural dynamics and external signals from the environment. We aim to frame this variability as an adaptive feature in unpredictable environments and to understand how neuromodulation may drive the emergence of inter-individual variation throughout development. Addressing this challenge requires the development of data-driven and theoretical tools to quantify differences between dynamical systems from time series observations. Building upon our recent work, we are looking for a MSc intern to work with our team on the development and application of data-driven approaches, grounded in statistical physics and dynamical systems theory, to analyze inter-individual variability in animal behavior. This project will be carried out within the framework of the ANR project FORE-SIGHT. The intern will be integrated into the SIBBIL team and will have the opportunity to interact with PhD students and postdoctoral researchers in an interdisciplinary and international research environment. MAIN MISSIONS The main goal of this internship is to compare data-driven approaches for the analysis of variability among time series of animal behavior. The intern will explore the performance of different modelling and inference techniques in terms of their robustness, interpretability, and reliability to noise. Under the supervision of Antonio Carlos Costa, the intern will be in charge of the following tasks: - Benchmarking different data-driven methods for measuring distance among time series observations from behaving animals - Evaluate the limits of different approacchs, and the conditions in which they work best Voir plus Profil recherché M1/M2 student in Physics, computer science or applied mathematics Know-how - Programming skills: python - Experience with data analysis and numerical experiments Knowledge - Good English level - Basic knowledge of statistical physics, dynamical systems, or machine learning (at least one) Soft-skills - Curiosity and motivation for interdisciplinary research - Ability to work independently while interacting within a research team - Good communicator The start date of the internship is flexible. Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design. Main Responsibilities As a Pharma & Life Sciences Senior Consultant in our Zurich office, you will be at the intersection of strategy consulting and data/AI innovation. You will: Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams (specifically in the Pharma & Life Sciences sector) to address high-stakes questions: How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organize for data? Which strategic programs deliver the most impact? Structured Problem-Solving: Break down complex challenges into clear, actionable recommendations, using frameworks and methodologies rooted in classic strategy consulting, enriched by Artefact’s data and AI expertise. Project Delivery: Support engagements end-to-end, from hypothesis framing and market/competitor analysis to client workshops, governance design, and implementation roadmaps. Client Engagement: Collaborate closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You’ll build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and ensure strategic alignment. Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact’s Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital (frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks), and participating in business development. Candidate Profile We are looking for an ambitious, analytically minded talent who is passionate about leveraging data and AI to solve business problems. The ideal candidate meets several of the following qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s and Master’s degree (preferred) in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics or a related field. An excellent academic track record is highly valued. Work Experience: Approximately 2–4 years of experience in strategy consulting, data/digital consulting, or business analyst roles, with a mandatory focus on the Pharma & Life Sciences sector and with hands-on exposure to data, analytics, or AI-driven projects. Pharma Domain Expertise: Strong grasp of the life sciences ecosystem, including regulatory environments, the drug development lifecycle, and digital health trends. Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A dual affinity for business and technology. You enjoy solving complex problems and can approach challenges in a structured, strategic way. Strong knowledge of data and digital technologies (e.g. analytics, AI, machine learning concepts, digital marketing, cloud platforms) is expected – you should be tech-savvy and eager to deepen your understanding of the data/AI domain. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with an ability to draw insights from data. You have an analytical mindset and are comfortable handling data-driven analysis to support decision making. Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. You can present complex ideas clearly and can adapt your message to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience creating impactful presentations or reports is a must. You also enjoy working collaboratively in teams and liaising with clients. Languages: Fluency in German and English (both written and spoken) is mandatory; French is a strong plus. Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland. Why Join Us Strategy with a Data Edge: Artefact is not a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure tech player — we sit uniquely at the crossroads, giving you the chance to build boardroom-level strategy expertise while being at the forefront of AI and digital transformation. Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team, you will have visibility and impact from day one. You will help shape Artefact’s footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership. Learning & Growth: Regular training in both strategy consulting methodologies and AI/data capabilities, combined with international exposure. Culture of Doers: Innovation, Action, Collaboration. We are entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and committed to delivering impact — while supporting each other’s growth. This position is based in Zürich . Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution. Notre équipe est en charge de garantir la performance des équipes commerciales, opérations (gestion de transport) et procurement et agit sur 3 leviers pour soutenir la croissance : - le support analytique et opérationnel aux équipes, - l’optimisation continue de nos processes et produits internes (notamment notre plateforme de gestion de transport et notre CRM), - l’identification et gestion de projets transverses d’innovation et de transformation de nos méthodologies et de notre organisation. En particulier, l’ équipe est en charge du déploiement de la stratégie IA pour les équipes métiers L’équipe travaille également en collaboration avec les équipes Produit & tech et Data pour mobiliser notre tech au service de la performance commerciale et opérationnelle. Vous aurez pour sujet de TFE : Offre de stage – Data science et surveillance des ouvrages d’art (ponts). Contexte La surveillance des ponts et, plus largement, des ouvrages d’art devient un enjeu majeur face au vieillissement des infrastructures et aux exigences accrues de sécurité. Les possibilités de collecte de données physiques issues d’instrumentations en temps réel (capteurs de déplacements, accélérations, déformations, etc.) se multiplient, générant de très grands volumes de données. Parallèlement, les technologies de data science et de machine learning offrent des perspectives prometteuses pour interpréter finement ces données et détecter précocement l’apparition d’endommagements ou de signes de vieillissement structurel. Toutefois, l’efficacité de ces approches dépend fortement : de la qualité des données d’apprentissage (niveau de bruit, sensibilité aux anomalies recherchées), de la présentation et de la structuration des données (data engineering), et du choix pertinent des algorithmes. Dans le cadre du développement d’un outil de détection automatique de l’endommagement structurel appuyé sur l'analyse des lignes d'influence (enregistrements de la déformation lors du passage d'un véhicule), nous avons collecté un important jeu de données physiques issues d’instrumentation réelle et recherchons un(e) stagiaire pour en exploiter pleinement le potentiel. Objectifs du stage : Contribuer à la mise en place d’une chaîne complète de traitement et d’analyse des données, depuis leur préparation jusqu’à l’extraction d’indicateurs sensibles à l’état de santé de l’ouvrage. Missions principales : Extraire la réponse de l’ouvrage sous sollicitations significatives à partir de données brutes issues de capteurs. Identifier, trier et catégoriser les données exploitables et non exploitables (qualité, bruit, défauts d’acquisition). Définir et calculer des grandeurs d’intérêt sensibles à l’endommagement structurel, par analyse croisée de plusieurs types de mesures physiques. Mettre en œuvre une démarche de data engineering pour structurer, nettoyer et valoriser les données. Réaliser des études de sensibilité, notamment à l’aide de modèles numériques (modélisation par éléments finis). Explorer et développer des approches de machine learning, en particulier pour l’analyse de séries temporelles, en vue de la détection d’anomalies ou d’évolutions anormales du comportement de l’ouvrage. Intérêt marqué pour les ouvrages d’art, la surveillance structurale et l’analyse de données réelles. Goût pour les approches mêlant physique, modélisation et data science. Compétences requises : Maîtrise indispensable de Python, notamment : NumPy, Pandas Expérience en machine learning, avec des bibliothèques telles que : scikit-learn, PyTorch (ou équivalent) Une expérience ou un intérêt pour le traitement de séries temporelles est un atout important.
